notablePrerequisites: Enough mana available to cast both Selective Memory and Primal Surge (the casting can be split over two turns).
description:
Cast Selective Memory, exiling all non-permanent cards from your library.
Cast Primal Surge, putting all cards from your library onto the battlefield.
Win the game the next time you would draw a card (immediately if there are any triggered/activated abilities from permanents upon Primal Surge's resolution).
